name: poll-timeout
description: An export that never leaves RUNNING must end the run cleanly rather than hang. This scenario also pins the poll budget: the budget is the poll_timeout CONFIG parameter (default 300 seconds, spent in 2-second intervals), because large-estate exports routinely take minutes and a small fixed budget imported nothing on every run. The scenario sets poll_timeout=10 so the walk makes exactly 5 status polls (plus the token and export-start calls: 7 requests) over about 8 seconds. request_count is asserted exactly so that any later change to the interval or the budget arithmetic shows up here rather than being merged silently. check_determinism is off because the scenario emits no assets, so a second run would compare two empty id lists at the cost of another 8 seconds.
